title: AI Coding Toolkit Repository Manifest
description: Comprehensive audit and registration manifest for all 30 requested repositories across Claude Code, Antigravity, OpenCode, and Kilo Code.

repositories.name: Caveman
repositories.notes: Extracted canonical arm from local test harness and registered in .agents/skills/caveman with .claude/skills/ symlink. Eliminates conversational filler and reduces context tokens by ~75% while keeping exact technical precision.

repositories.name: Ponytail
repositories.notes: Active project standard in AGENTS.md. Enforces Understand → Smallest Complete Change → Verify → Stop.

repositories.name: Build With Claude
repositories.notes: Indexed as central reference hub for Claude commands, hooks, plugins, and custom prompt templates.

repositories.name: ECC (Everything Claude Code)
repositories.notes: Harness performance optimization system. Core skills mapped to local .agents/skills/ and referenced in token-saver and skill-scout.

repositories.name: Superpowers
repositories.notes: 15 core skills discovered in user Claude plugin cache (~/.claude/plugins/cache/claude-plugins-official/superpowers/6.4.1/). Reused canonical copies in .agents/skills/superpowers and .agents/skills/using-superpowers.

repositories.name: Vercel Agent Skills

repositories.name: I Have ADHD
